title: Baby Jaynita Sitting in Floral Armchair, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot of an infant, captioned 'Jaynita' in pencil on the front lower margin, perched inside a floral upholstered armchair. The baby is dressed in a light-colored long-sleeve gown and knitted booties, looking attentively at the camera with soft indoor light coming from a nearby window.
